pluteus, pluteī m.

noun, second declension

Its other sense is a parapet.

Examples

  • prīmum liber ē pluteō ēlēctus

    first a book chosen from the shelfLibellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

See also scaffold platform.
